text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited at all times on the north side of Albright Avenue, between Foch Avenue and Sunset Avenue. The proposed amendment will deter parking in this location and will improve vehicle movements by maintaining a clear passage for vehicles.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the north side of Albright Avenue, between Foch Avenue and Sunset Avenue.
